mods.name: Transmitter Pearl
mods.description: Its supposed to be usless but for some reason its not?

releases.notes:
This is the initial and final release of Transmitter Pearl.

  Features
   - Added the Transmitter Pearl item for entity position swapping.
   - Implemented entity linking (Right-Click) and transmission (Left-Click) mechanics.
   - Support for cross-dimensional teleportation between linked targets.
   - Added a durability system with 10 uses, repairable using Redstone Blocks.
   - Included a player trust system to manage teleportation permissions.
   - Added administrative gamerules for trust enforcement and crafting toggles.

  Project Status
   - This is a one-time, exclusive release. 
   - No further updates, bug fixes, or ports are planned.
   - The project is fully open-source and derived from the Pocket Lint mod.

readmeSummary: Transmitter Pearl is a utility mod that introduces a specialized tool for tactical repositioning.
